ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are statistical ties on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 82.7, under the 2.0-point variance threshold), so capability didn't decide it. I used task preference as the tiebreaker. This is a high-latitude, open-ended creative invention task with a friendly tone — exactly the profile Lapwing reports the strongest appetite for, while Plover self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work. Since preferences don't affect output quality, this is purely a sensible tiebreak when capability is even.
